title: PATH-WM · Architecture atlas
intro: A map of the implemented components and their interfaces, from the agent loop to attention blocks. The general categorical agent, the Gaussian photo experiment, and the entity experiments are distinct configurations. A drawn module indicates implementation, not proven general capability.

graphs.subtitle: General categorical agent · runtime data and control flow

discussion.scope: Red = a dedicated discussion remains. Blue = discussed, with validation still incomplete. Green = validated within the explicitly labelled test scope, not general capability. Discussion coverage is retained separately, including for green parts that still need a walkthrough. Evidence refers to the recorded configurations and must be revisited after relevant changes.

world.basis: Discussed webcam footage, real versus synthetic data, and desired image/video/audio/text interaction.
world.next: Revisit concrete sensor and environment choices when integrating them.

input.basis: Desired inputs were discussed; the observation-adapter/event contract has only appeared in the architecture map.
input.next: Walk through timestamps, modality synchronization, missing/late packets and event commits.

validation.label: Event mechanics
validation.scope: Packet deduplication/order, one action/time advance per event, commit-once and masked-input handling.
validation.limits: Live webcam capture, cross-device synchronization and real streaming are not validated. Discussion walkthrough still pending.

encode.basis: Discussed modality stems, residual transformer blocks per scale, hierarchy merges, fusion, temporal handling and reconstruction probes. On 14 September, the user asked whether architectural structure and a small parameter count can reduce visual training-data requirements. On 15 September, the user specified a spatial VAE with separate lossless rearrangement, residual processing and channel projection; Claude review was reconciled.
encode.next: Opt-in spatial VAE v2 now implements the R/P/M/C stem, coarsest self-attention/shared loop and detached stage probes. Mechanics, exact GPU resume and ten real-photo learning sanity gates pass; all photo-quality screens fail. See docs/spatial-vae-v2-plan.md and runs/spatial_vae_v2/verification.json. Color diagnosis now finds reduced readout access at the final posterior projection and sampling; see docs/spatial-vae-color-plan.md. Current agent integration, semantic retention, fine detail and matched-resource/data-efficiency studies remain open; the high-level encoder stays blue. Two-seed sampled-color supervision now improves global chroma error81–83% without new parameters/inference work; achieved KL rises37–41% and grids remain. See docs/spatial-vae-repair-plan.md. Color-only is a diagnostic candidate, not a full repair; high-level status stays blue. All four modality interfaces now have isolated and mixed packet/mask/gradient/restart checks. Four-word and four-tone direct fitting pass; a video foreground repair fails total RGB quality. State-conditioned adapters and general multimodal semantics remain untrained in this audit. See docs/modality-foundation-plan.md; high-level status stays blue.

belief.basis: Discussed latent world/entity beliefs conceptually, but not the actual categorical predict/correct mechanism with h, codes and logits.
belief.next: Walk through one observation: prior prediction, posterior correction, uncertainty and recurrent state.

memory.basis: Discussed recent inputs, hierarchical history, external entity storage, retrieval, latent versus raw evidence and provenance. On 15 September, reviewed the user-proposed multimodal World State: stable IDs, learned components/relations, evidence, reversible attribution and optional spatial representations. See docs/world-state-proposal-review.md.
memory.next: The requested modular foundation is now implemented with versioned components, provenance, atomic session commits, revocable aliases, dependent-state invalidation/replay and bounded retrieval. See docs/world-state.md. Next: real candidate/identity/state tests, learned retrieval, abstention calibration and controlled comparisons. General concept induction remains a separate capability milestone.

validation.label: Storage / causal reads
validation.scope: Exact recent envelopes, bounded hierarchy, source/belief separation and causal reads. The optional World State adds tested transactional identity/provenance/correction mechanics, pinned historical retrieval and exact session/training restart on the supplied-descriptor development task. Audio/video/text and image packets now pass separate and mixed actual WorldSession/thinker paths after correcting a four-versus-eight categorical-code memory mismatch.
validation.limits: This validates storage and replay mechanics, not general entity recognition, concept induction, calibrated uncertainty, useful learned retrieval or long-horizon recall. The photo recall path still loses accessible detail. Full-agent historical evaluation must restore the corresponding neural session, not just query an old store revision. Real media transport and tiny direct codec fitting do not establish state-conditioned output quality or cross-modal identity.

workspace.basis: Discussed focus on entities and relationships, recalled context, internal thinking and interleaving internal/external actions. Reviewed separate binding-candidate and task retrieval, with bounded evidence/context and an explicit unresolved result.
workspace.next: The optional World State now feeds bounded component/relation tokens into the actual thinker, with replaceable query/context modules and shared training/runtime projections. A tiny paired-history task works. Compare oracle, flat episodic, structured and no-history conditions on held-out tasks; general learned retrieval and stopping remain open.

request.basis: Discussed broad goals, complex tasks and decomposition; the instruction-to-task contract has not had a dedicated walkthrough.
request.next: Define task tokens, output controls, completion criteria and who verifies success.

plan.basis: Discussed action DAGs, predicted states, goal reachability, subgoals, new observations and replanning.
plan.next: General DAG construction and learned search remain proposed, even though the topic has been discussed.

validation.label: Bounded search mechanics
validation.scope: Fixed-horizon candidate evaluation, common sampling, caller-state preservation and RNG restoration; supplied key-box search has independent replay.
validation.limits: This does not validate learned dynamics, general goal achievement or the proposed action DAG. The linked initial key-box integrated capability screen failed.

evidence.label: Independent search replay; integrated screen failed

emit.basis: Discussed every encoder/decoder pair, state-conditioned outputs, image detail, conditional generation and replacement interfaces. On 15 September, discussed a mirrored PixelShuffle VAE decoder, Gaussian loss/KL units and a future state-conditioned spatial-latent producer.
emit.next: Separate v1/v2 VAE decoders support exact saved-latent replay and variable geometry; v2 has a latent-only convolution/PixelShuffle decoder with final RGB projection. Ten photo fits still fail the quality screen; rates and common-target stage probes are measured in docs/spatial-vae-v2-plan.md. Constant latent controls locate decoder grids at learned subpixel phase channels; mean-only decoder fitting improves color but fails sampled-output reliability. See docs/spatial-vae-color-plan.md. State-conditioned generation, fine detail and other modalities remain open; this high-level output node stays blue. Two-seed sampled-color supervision now improves global chroma error81–83% without new parameters/inference work; achieved KL rises37–41% and grids remain. See docs/spatial-vae-repair-plan.md. Color-only is a diagnostic candidate, not a full repair; high-level status stays blue. All four modality interfaces now have isolated and mixed packet/mask/gradient/restart checks. Four-word and four-tone direct fitting pass; a video foreground repair fails total RGB quality. State-conditioned adapters and general multimodal semantics remain untrained in this audit. See docs/modality-foundation-plan.md; high-level status stays blue.

act.basis: Discussed examples of physical/software actions and internal/external distinctions; the concrete action/execution interface has not been walked through.
act.next: Connect action-head outputs to typed tool/physical commands, durations, execution outcomes and feedback.

reflect.basis: Discussed reusing modality encoders for recalled/generated material while routing it into focus rather than treating it as a new observation.
reflect.next: Distinguish the implemented generated-output reflection path from proposed raw-memory replay.

validation.label: Routing / provenance
validation.scope: Re-encoded generated outputs can change workspace while leaving physical belief/history unchanged; generated content cannot enter source evidence.
validation.limits: Useful self-reflection and quality of generated content are not established by these routing tests.

notes: Each later scale consumes the fully processed previous scale. The final fusion is optional: f=0 in the general defaults, f=2 in the current photo checkpoint. k and scale count are recipe choices.

Image merging pools 2×2 spatial patches. Video also pools adjacent frames; audio and text pool adjacent sequence positions. Video has causal temporal attention and pooling within the supplied window, not a separate persistent recurrent video cell.
Masks prevent reading later support. The categorical source-evidence path uses no task, belief or feature-controller conditioning. Optional controls apply on permitted task/reflection paths.
Example for the photo configuration: RGB64 → 16×16 → 8×8 → 4×4, all width32; k=2 and f=2. The hierarchy emits 336 tokens.

Image/video/audio/text encoders now share output-neutral attention diagnostics: traced and ordinary outputs, gradients and RNG agree exactly in train/eval checks. Masks exclude invalid values before learned operations. The isolated modality audit fits tiny examples; real AV/text is a resampled transport check, not learned understanding.

graphs.title: 3 · Inside a residual attention block
graphs.subtitle: Attention reads representations; a query head is not a persistent memory slot
nodes:

Positions / state slots to update

Normalize context

Multi-head attention
Masked softmax(QKᵀ / √d) · V
Concatenate heads → output projection

First residual
u = x + attention output

Second residual
y = u + MLP output

Optional feature code
Bias-free map → bounded scale / shift

Attention constraints
Validity · time · local footprint
notes: Self-attention uses the same token set as query and context; cross-attention uses distinct sets. Attend uses four heads by default. Learned query tokens acquire roles through their consumer and training targets.

Q/K/V projection weights are learned parameters. Their per-input activations perform a read; memory records are stored separately. Neither attention weights nor readable slot names guarantee a semantic interpretation.

ConditionedBlock adds bounded scale/shift on query and MLP normalization; code zero is neutral. Its time/support masks are richer than the simpler Attend block. OutputBlock (§9) adds separate self-attention and context-attention residuals.

Attend and ConditionedBlock use one detached attention_probabilities helper for pre-dropout inspection. Native attention keeps need_weights=False even when recording; diagnostic weights do not switch the output kernel. Invalid decoder context is zeroed before normalization/projection. Tests cover exact output, gradient and RNG neutrality for all four multiscale encoders.

With no usable observation, the prior is retained and no source-memory record is written. Imagination runs the prior transition without correction, marks the result hypothetical and shares live memory read-only.
Events are caller-owned transactions with ordered IDs. Partial packet arrivals are corrected against one prior and one memory snapshot. Source times and state time remain distinct.

Categorical entropy is a diagnostic; it is not established calibrated confidence or model-parameter uncertainty. The Gaussian log_scale inherited for compatibility is zero here, not the belief uncertainty.

notes: These capacities are general defaults, not universal constants. Source and inferred views stay separate through compression; categorical probabilities, not only sampled codes, reach belief readers.
Storage is caller-owned bounded tensors and records. Reading attends over the stores directly; this is not yet a scalable indexed external database or an unbounded raw-media archive.

Exact recent storage means exact latent copies, not exact raw pixels. Compression loses detailed source alignment; support intervals and bounded source labels are retained. Learned read/compression quality needs its own evaluation.
The photo experiment uses simpler episodic top-k snapshots instead (§8). The explicit entity store (§10) is another separate mechanism.

In emit, task tokens first condition a thinking step, then modality decoders consume the conditioned state. General decoders see all state tokens; the photo wrapper intentionally exposes only its working/reasoning tokens.

The feature controller can propose a bounded feature code for supported reads. It is excluded from categorical source encoding. Reflection uses shared encoder weights but preserves generated ancestry; it is not a new camera event.

finish is a policy/session operation, not independent proof of task success. The historical-recall experiment has an external verifier based on the delivered event log. General tool execution, open-ended decomposition and calibrated stopping remain incomplete.

The text path is a byte autoregressor, not a pretrained language model. The waveform path is not established general speech synthesis. Video currently decodes a supplied state trajectory; there is no general video diffusion generator in this recipe.

Image resolution and audio length are constructor settings. Output size alone does not establish reconstructed detail. The stronger conditional image producer is an optional controlled experiment, not a common generator already implemented for every modality.

Native image/audio/text decoders accept context validity; text keeps a separate causal prefix mask. Video validates every state, including singleton trajectories. The independent codec audit learns four words and four tones; weighted video reconstruction improves object/motion but degrades total RGB. Its state-to-output path is untrained and measured only on the first example; no bottleneck-location or general generation claim.

The next proposed photo repair is intermediate spatial supervision of observation/state updates and recall. It is not implemented by this diagram work.

notes: The intended agent learns representations and which connections are useful. Stable IDs are bookkeeping; readable labels are revisable interpretations. These boxes are conceptual distinctions, not mandatory database fields or one vector each.

The opt-in pathwm.world_state package implements the store, binding, recurrent update, bounded retrieval, context projections and actual thinker connection. Optional prototype, self/control, feedback, prediction and modulation clients have concrete tensor/record APIs; their useful learned behavior is not established. Discrete storage is outside autograd; neural forwards remain trainable. Action authority belongs to the harness.

81 scoped tests and 3293 independent checks pass; a 96-update CPU task using supplied descriptors preserves two identities and answers paired histories. Complete checkpoints match a 48+48 resumed run exactly. This is development evidence, not real-image recognition or sample-efficiency proof. General concept discovery, learned graph topology, retrieval calibration, scalable indexing and skill acquisition remain open. Structural report QA passes; browser interaction QA is unavailable under the existing local-file policy.

A recognition latent cannot automatically be decoded into a faithful face or image. That requires a compatible trained decoder and retained information; a reconstruction is evidence about a readout, not a literal picture of all the agent's beliefs.

The foundation now connects audio/video/text/image packets with masked CandidateEncoder.pool over supplied regions/spans. Whole-window pooling is a lossy baseline, not discovery. Candidate provenance must retain source ancestry; generated/recalled candidates cannot become new evidence. Modality representation spaces remain separately versioned until alignment is trained. 112 scoped tests and actual real audiovisual/UTF-8 transport pass; general identity and state-to-output learning remain open.
